## Profile

Epidemiologist working on causal pharmacoepidemiology at CNIO, estimating what medicines do to the risk of cancer by emulating target trials on routine health records, mainly in pancreatic and bladder cancer. PhD-trained in causal inference and evidence triangulation, with g-methods, negative controls and Mendelian randomization applied across international cohorts (HELIX, ATHLETE). Builds reproducible analysis pipelines in R and Python; author of the CRAN packages forrest and orcidtr and lead developer of the **etverse** ecosystem for transparent causal inference.
